description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Sidebar' that provides UI controls for filtering and searching recipes, including cuisine selection and tag toggling. It synchronizes its state with URL query parameters for navigation and filtering functionality.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: React component implementing a sidebar with search and filter controls for recipes.

methods.name: updateParam
methods.description: Updates URL search parameters and navigates to reflect changes in filter selections.

methods.name: toggleTag
methods.description: Toggles tags in the filter set and updates URL parameters accordingly.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the search form to update the query parameter.
